# Castles & Crusades — GameOnMagill

Independent community character sheet by David Magill. Version 0.21.54.22.19.

Includes class and racial abilities, attribute checks, equipment and armour calculations, and spell resources. Single-class progression has completed a live testing pass with sampled rolls. Dual Class and multiclass behaviour still require a dedicated testing pass.

Select your race and class on the sheet, then enter attributes and class level. Use Core for common rolls, Abilities for full ability records, Magic for spell resources and the spellbook, and Tools for configuration and repair. Consult Help & Documentation in the sheet.

Castles & Crusades is a product of Troll Lord Games. This is an independently developed community sheet.

Known issue under investigation: Dragon Mount imported with no resolved caster; changing its List field did not resolve the reported case.
